title: Jude: Out of the Floodlights
overview: Based on unprecedented behind-the-scenes access, see Jude's emotional departure from BVB Dortmund; the highlights of his record-breaking first season at Real Madrid and finally the heartbreak of England's UEFA Euro '24 final defeat in Berlin.  In a series of exclusive interviews, Jude reveals his inner most thoughts on a remarkable year - from scoring the decisive goals in both El Clasicos, to winning the Kopa Trophy and being named Golden Boy and La Liga Player of the Year.  Using stunning match action and intimate family archive, enjoy the most illuminating portrait of this young talent to date as he explains the importance of family and friends. See as he reflects on the problems of racism in football, the pressures of playing for his country and the realities of dealing with adverse coverage in written and social media.
